manage.title: Manage login security
manage.description: See the second factor status and change login security settings.

idleTimeoutMinutes.label: Sign out after idle minutes
idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Sign people out after this many minutes without activity. The server ends the session too, so a copied token stops working. 0 turns it off.

maxSessionHours.label: Longest session in hours
maxSessionHours.description: Sessions end after this many hours, even with remember me. 0 means no extra limit.

rememberDevice.label: Allow remember me
rememberDevice.description: Off hides remember me at login and ignores devices remembered before, so every login asks for the second factor.

secondFactor.label: Require a second factor
secondFactor.description: People without one must set one up after they sign in, before they can use Termix. A passkey sign in with a PIN or fingerprint counts.

applyToExternal.label: Also for single sign-on
applyToExternal.description: Ask for the second factor after SSO and LDAP logins too. Leave it off when your identity provider already asks for one.

connectFactor.label: Ask for a second factor before connecting
connectFactor.description: People enter their second factor when they open a terminal, remote desktop or file manager on a host. Metrics, tunnels and other background work are not asked.

connectFactorMinutes.label: Minutes before asking again
connectFactorMinutes.description: After entering it, a person can connect to any host for this long. Signing out ends it early.

requireConnectFactor.label: Ask for a second factor before connecting
requireConnectFactor.description: Used when Login Security is set to ask on hosts marked for it.

verify.title: Verify second factor
verify.intro: Enter your second factor to connect to this host.
verify.retry: Go back to the host and connect again.
verify.failed: That did not work. Try again.
verify.noFactorHint: Set one up in Settings, Security, then connect again.

status.noFactors: No second factor is installed. Install a plugin like TOTP or WebAuthn so people can set one up.
status.failed: Could not check which second factors are installed.

setup.title: Set up a second factor
setup.body: Your admin requires a second factor to sign in. Set one up below to keep using Termix.
setup.none: Nothing to set up here? Ask your admin to install a second factor plugin.
